source: Open Food Facts (https://world.openfoodfacts.org/), ODbL. off_multi.tsv read 6 Oct 2026 (16 countries, one snapshot); brand tags for the India check from off_india.csv read 1 Oct 2026.
note: Open Food Facts is filled in by volunteers, so no country's numbers are a random sample of its shops. A product tagged as sold in two countries counts in both. Medians: k = packs with a usable value, n = every pack in the category; shares: k of n lists, pct = 100*k/n rounded once. ok=False means fewer than MIN_K packs behind the cell: not for headlines. Drinks are per 100 ml as entered on Open Food Facts. English-list measures cover English-label countries only.
